persona: Mid-level ad ops executive at a digital media company
resumeText:
Neha Agarwal | Gurugram | neha.agarwal@example.com

EXPERIENCE
Ad Operations Executive, Saffron Media Exchange, Gurugram (2021 - present)
- Trafficked display and video campaigns in Google Ad Manager, setting up orders, line items and creatives.
- Set up private marketplace deals and programmatic guaranteed deals in DV360 for agency buyers.
- Implemented and tested VAST tags, third-party ad tags and tracking pixels before every launch.
- Monitored daily campaign pacing and fixed under-delivery by adjusting targeting and frequency caps.
- Built weekly delivery reports in Excel with pivot tables for the sales team.
- Coordinated with sales and client teams on launch timelines and creative specs.

EDUCATION
BBA, Delhi University, 2021

SKILLS
Integral Ad Science, HTML, Google Analytics
